moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: We’re aiming to reach 30+ Starship launches/day in 2030 (~10k annualized). Still tiny compared to airplane flights!
moments.why: Astronomical ambition from Musk about SpaceX’s launch goals—sparking debate among tech and space enthusiasts.

moments.author: Tyreek Hill
moments.quote: Still no power in my left leg… timeline looking real good right now, man.
moments.why: A raw rehab update from a star athlete after a gruesome injury—generating buzz among sports and fantasy football fans.

moments.author: Jon Ossoff
moments.quote: He doesn’t want to do the job; he wants to build his ballroom and travel with Natalie on their apparently defenseless flying palace…
moments.why: A viral political sound bite painting a vivid critique of Trump and his inner circle—dominating political chatter.
